items.title: Florian J. "Curly" Lizana Interview, 1966-05-18
items.q: I took Sharky right over here at Blutsey, I played a week's engagement there. I took him over there. And he couldn't play on three home. He couldn't play much. I told him to play, keep fighting.

ctx.x: I helped, I helped quite a few of them.
Yeah, I know Sharky very well. I know Sharky, but Sharky wasn't Sharky.
